coordinate_system: zero-based column,row as viewed on the physical device; utility keys are separate from cockpit controls

manuals.name: DCS F-16C Early Access Guide EN

VSDXL.title: ELEC / ENGINE
VSDXL.notes: Composite of small left-console panels. MAIN PWR above ELEC RESET; engine controls vertical. FUEL MASTER / blank TANK INERTING / ENG FEED / AIR REFUEL retain columns. TEST controls form a three-over-one cluster. JFS START 1/2 remain separate momentary commands.

VSDXL.title: AVIONICS POWER
VSDXL.notes: Five upper switches, GPS/DL below, INS lower-left and MIDS lower-right. Positions quantized to five columns from the panel illustration.

VSDXL.title: HUD PANEL
VSDXL.notes: Four upper switches and three lower switches; the unmapped TEST switch position remains empty.

VSDXL.title: SNSR / AIR / OXY
VSDXL.notes: Sensor-power switches retain their real left-to-right row. Single-control environmental panels occupy separate blocks; the composite is not a scale model of the full console.

VSDXL.title: FLCS / TEST
VSDXL.notes: DIG BACKUP upper-left, ALT FLAPS upper-right, LE FLAPS lower-left. Separate TEST cluster: FIRE / OBOGS / LAMP above EPU GEN. TRIM/AP represents its separate manual-trim panel.

VSDXL.title: ECM PANEL
VSDXL.notes: Power/XMIT on the left; modules 1-4 in the upper row, module 5 below module 1, BIT below XMIT. Unmapped FRM/SPL positions stay empty.

VSDXL.title: EXT LIGHTING
VSDXL.notes: ANTI COLL / POSITION / WING-TAIL / FUSELAGE across the upper row, MASTER centered below. FORM and AAR are operated on the N4 Pro knobs.

VSDN4Pro.title: AUDIO / SENSOR
VSDN4Pro.notes: Sensor switches keep their four-column row. Physical knobs retain COMM1 / COMM2 / MSL / THREAT order; the single physical knob row cannot reproduce AUDIO1's two-row geometry.

VSDN4Pro.title: HUD PANEL
VSDN4Pro.notes: Both rows of the HUD panel are visible together. The two physical brightness knobs are helper controls from the ICP/HMCS panels.

VSDN4Pro.title: AVIONICS POWER
VSDN4Pro.notes: Upper/middle portion of the real power panel: five switches across, GPS under MFD and DL under UFC. INS/MIDS are on the following page.

VSDN4Pro.title: INS / MIDS
VSDN4Pro.notes: Lower portion of the same power panel, shown as its own viewport. INS and MIDS preserve the columns used on the XL.

VSDN4Pro.title: INT LIGHTING
VSDN4Pro.notes: Instrument-panel brightness occupies the center knob, DED brightness the right knob, and flood-console brightness the left knob. The physical single-row constraint is retained; unrelated HUD/radar controls are removed from this lighting page.

VSDN4Pro.title: EXT LIGHTING
VSDN4Pro.notes: Four upper controls and MASTER centered below. FORM uses the left physical knob and AAR the right-side knob, matching their relative panel columns.

VSDN4Pro.title: AIR / OXY
VSDN4Pro.notes: AIR SOURCE above the oxygen SUPPLY control; ANTI ICE belongs to its separate neighboring panel.

VSDN4Pro.title: ELEC / TEST
VSDN4Pro.notes: Electrical controls form a vertical pair. The separate TEST cluster retains FIRE / OBOGS / LAMP across its top and EPU GEN below OBOGS.
